Basics

Paprika cottage cheese

Paprikás túró

8 months+ Replaced 15 min 4 portions

From 8 months, a small spoon on soft vegetables or bread the child already manages. If milk is new, try the first taste in the morning on a well day.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 100 g pasteurized cottage cheese (unsalted)
  • 1 tsp sweet paprika (mild, not hot)
  • 1 tbsp cooked onion (boiled until soft, then cooled; not raw)
  • 1 tbsp plain pasteurized yogurt (only if the cheese is stiff)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Cook the chopped onion in water until soft, then drain and cool it.
  2. Mash the cottage cheese until smooth.
  3. Stir in the onion and sweet paprika.
  4. Add yogurt if the mix is stiff.
  5. Serve with no salt.

Replaced

The usual spiced cheese spread is salty and sharp with onion.

Stir pasteurized cottage cheese with sweet paprika and a little cooked onion, and add no salt.
